**Blues Scale in the Key of A**

|------|---------------------------------|----------------|
| A    | Root (tonic)                    | –              |
| C    | Minor 3rd (b3)                  | +3             |
| D    | Perfect 4th (4)                 | +2             |
| Eb   | Diminished 5th / Augmented 4th (b5) | +1         |
| E    | Perfect 5th (5)                 | +1             |
| G    | Minor 7th (b7)                  | +3             |
| A    | Octave (back to root)           | +2             |

**Pattern of intervals (semitone steps):**  
`3 – 2 – 1 – 1 – 3 – 2`

**In note form:**  
`A – C – D – Eb – E – G – (A)`

So, the A blues scale consists of the notes **A, C, D, Eb, E, G**, following the interval pattern of a minor 3rd, major 2nd, minor 2nd, minor 2nd, major 3rd, and major 2nd.
